description: This file defines the PersonAttributeType entity class in a Java-based OpenMRS project. It models the metadata for person attributes, including properties like format, foreign key, searchability, and edit privileges. It also includes methods for accessing and manipulating these properties, as well as implementing comparison logic.

classes.name: PersonAttributeType
classes.description: Entity class representing types of person attributes in OpenMRS, with properties such as format, foreign key, searchability, and privilege requirements. Implements Comparable and supports Hibernate and Jackson annotations.
